title: run_admin_server uses .expect() — panic kills admin silently on error
description: sieve_admin.rs: axum::serve(listener, app).await.expect('Sieve admin server error'). If axum::serve returns an error, the task panics. In a tokio::spawn task, the panic is caught by the runtime — the task aborts but the main process continues. The operator has no indication the admin API has stopped. Scripts can no longer be managed. Fix: match on the error and log at error level, then either restart the listener or terminate the process.
